_comment: The index of the config-contract corpus. Every case here is run twice:
once through the HCL implementation of the invariants (registry.tf, driven
by ../registry.tftest.hcl) and once through the Go implementation of the
verdict on every case, because both are gates a real deployment passes
through and either one being wrong lets a bad config reach a provider.
'name' is not decoration: contract_test.go asserts that each one appears as
a run block in registry.tftest.hcl, and that every .json file in this
directory is claimed by at least one case. Adding a fixture to one side
only fails the build rather than quietly halving its coverage.

cases.name: valid_config_plans_cleanly
cases.because: The baseline every other fixture is a single mutation away from.

cases.name: unknown_site_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: -site names a key that has to exist before anything else is worth checking.

cases.name: vendor_mismatch_fails_the_vault_attestation_precondition
cases.because: The vault item's credentials were swapped for another vendor's without updating its provider field.

cases.name: unimplemented_vendor_fails_even_when_config_and_vault_agree
cases.because: Config and vault agree with each other on a vendor the code does not implement - the case a two-way check cannot see.

cases.name: missing_vault_provider_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: A blank attestation is not agreement; it is the absence of one.

cases.name: octet_out_of_range_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: Octet 100 collides with the Kubernetes service range at 10.96.0.0/12.

cases.name: duplicate_octet_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: Two sites owning one /16 present as a broken network rather than a config mistake.

cases.name: no_hypervisor_nodes_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: There is nowhere to place a VM, and every later phase assumes nodes[0] exists.

cases.name: control_plane_count_below_one_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: A control plane with no members is not a cluster.

cases.name: aws_shaped_access_key_fails_on_a_cloudflare_site
cases.because: Catches the careless swap, where credentials are pasted in without touching any declaration at all.

cases.name: negative_worker_count_fails_its_precondition
cases.because: Zero workers is a real and common answer - it is the estate epoch 01 shipped - so the count cannot simply be required to be positive. Negative is the one value that is meaningless, and it would otherwise reach range() in variables.tf.
